function.name: get_current_weather
function.description: Get current weather conditions including temperature, wind, humidity, and weather description.

latitude.description: Latitude (optional, uses configured location if omitted)

longitude.description: Longitude (optional, uses configured location if omitted)

function.name: get_hourly_forecast
function.description: Get hourly weather forecast for the next 24-168 hours. Includes temperature, precipitation, wind speed, and weather code.

hours.description: Number of hours to forecast (default: 24, max: 168)

outputType.description: Output format: text (default) or pdf (returns downloadable PDF report as base64 file).

function.name: get_daily_forecast
function.description: Get daily weather forecast for the next 1-16 days. Includes high/low temperatures, precipitation sum, sunrise/sunset.

days.description: Number of days to forecast (default: 7, max: 16)

function.name: geocode_weather_city
function.description: Look up the coordinates (latitude, longitude) for a city name. Useful for finding coordinates to pass to other weather tools.

city.description: City name to look up (e.g. "Vienna", "New York")
